name: NAIRA NIWAS · one building, one window a post
one_line: The season told as one blush Bombay-Deco co-op building, three bays wide and four storeys tall: every post is a reel or a moving carousel that finds its window, opens it and lights it on one true moment of Indian housing-society life with one real Naira piece inside, and the twelve covers, posted in order, assemble on the profile into the building itself, lit from the shops at street level to a wedding on the terrace.
organising_idea_kept_whole: One drawn building, twelve bays, the exact shape of the 3 x 4 profile grid. Every reel opens on the whole building at one third scale (which IS the profile grid), finds this week's window, opens it, lights it, lets the real piece catch the light, lands one line, and pulls back to a building with one more window lit; every carousel's slide 1 is a moving window whose frame 0 is the cover. Storeys are weeks (shops, first floor, second floor, terrace), flats are a recurring cast seen only through their things (101 Aai, 103 the siblings, 202 the evening-walk friend, 203 the spare-key neighbour), the blush kandil hangs at the same spot on every cover and the brass nameplate sits at the same spot under every window. The building is drawn; the life inside it is photographed; the jewellery is always the real listing photograph at true relative scale. Nothing in this selection changes that idea: every change is a fix inside it or a graft re-skinned into it.
why: All four V3 judges named NAIRA NIWAS as the Variation 3 to build, each from a different lens, and it finished first on every scorecard: brand and truth 78, commerce 80, motion craft 81, reference grid 84, total 323 of 400 (DRAWN FROM LIFE 314, NAIRA GALLI 302, THE BOX THEATRE 300). It is the only proposal in which the movement, the grid and the season are one idea: each reel opens on the profile itself at one third scale and lights one window, so non-follower reach turns into a reason to visit the profile, and on 22 Nov the finished profile is the lit building. Its world (present-day Mumbai and Nashik co-op society life: the watchman's desk, LOST: ONE EARRING by the lift, kahi nako on Padwa, the borrowed necklace, the disputed window seat, the terrace rehearsal) is new against A's matching counter and B's Mummy's-house nostalgia, and it is the buyer's life now, not her childhood. It runs at the owner's own tempo (the kandil turns once in 10 s, the box drawer uses the site's 1.1 s / 1.0 s), it is mostly 2D geometry agents draw well with photographs inside the windows (the lowest amateur risk of the three high scorers), and its captions already sell like A's (BUY line on 7 posts, baskets on 7, COD). Its faults were word, mark and slot problems, not concept problems: a typed NAIRA next to the real wordmark, 'emerald-green', 'made to stay gold.', a kitchen still life on Dhanteras, a headline-less Diwali cover, a soft second moon, short end-card holds and three carousels whose slide 1 only swept light. Every one is fixed below. DRAWN FROM LIFE was the runner-up on every lens but repeats six of A's and B's ideas and rests on twelve AI anatomy plates; GALLI is the same Bombay-Deco register done denser with a weaker grid; THE BOX THEATRE owns the box but sells packaging before jewellery and repeats MANGAL twice. Their best devices are grafted in where they fit the building.

scoreboard.recommendations: 4 of 4 judges: build NAIRA NIWAS. Runner-up named by 4 of 4: DRAWN FROM LIFE, only if its P1 AI line plate is proven first and its A/B repeats are re-concepted.
scoreboard.calibration_against_A_and_B: Commerce rubric: A about 80, B about 76, NIWAS 80 before fixes ('matches A and beats it once fixed'). Reference rubric: A about 78, B about 83, NIWAS 84 ('beats both'). Motion lens: 'beats both clearly'. Brand lens: A stays the truest feed; NIWAS beats B and closes on A once the typed brand name, 'emerald-green' and 'made to stay gold.' are fixed, all of which are fixed here.

how_it_beats_A_and_B: Motion is the idea, at post level and at season level. All 12 posts move (6 reels, 6 carousels whose slide 1 is a moving window), against A's 2 reels and 10 stills and B's 3 reels. Each reel opens on the profile grid itself and lights one window; the season accumulates on screen and on the profile, and P12's pull-back frame is the finished profile.

The grid is one picture. Twelve bays make one Deco building standing on the LAC pavement of the live row, pilasters and string courses run across every gutter, storeys darken from lit shops to wedding night, the terrace row shares one sky and one string-light wire, and the real wordmark crowns the top-left tile. A is a shade card and B a poster wall; neither composes the profile as one image.

Newer wit, same honesty. Present-day co-op society life (watchman, notice by the lift, spare-key neighbour, kahi nako, the borrowed necklace) is ground neither A nor B touches, and no Indian demi-fine brand has claimed it. Every joke is a listing truth: the cuff 'opens' (2.5 cm opening), 'two endings ... across a small gap', 'sold as a set of two', 'hinged snap', 'brushed satin, not mirror', 'cool and quiet ... the only warmth at the front'.

It sells like A. The exact BUY line runs on 11 of 12 captions (all but the Dhanteras honesty post), a named basket on 9 posts, the service line (box, free insured shipping, COD) on all 12 end cards and first comments, the gift guide lands Sun 1 Nov noon, the Bhaubeej send 8 days early, and a three-piece BUY3 set sits on the top-left tile every ad visitor lands on from 22 Nov.

It does not re-skin either option. After the fixes no post repeats an A or B idea-and-piece pair: Karwa Chauth goes to the bangle shop, not the moon (A and B both use the moon); the four-colour huggie row that echoed A's P7 is cut; the neckline-length slide that would echo A's P9 is declined; the kandil is the emblem, never A's 'stays up through Kartik' Diwali joke; the finale is the green set while A and B both close on Ruby (12 in stock, selling about one a day).

It is the safer motion build of the high scorers: one C-WORLD file, twelve bay components with three states, seven reusable moves, 17 AI layer plates of props and textures (no jewellery, faces, hands or text), the CSS box already proven in kit/motion/demo-box.html and the shopfront in kit/motion/demo.html.

system_changes.wordmark_and_name: Images never set NAIRA in type. The real kit wordmark is the building's name: on the brass nameplate under every window (P2, P4 to P11: kit/naira-wordmark-ink.svg at 86% opacity on the brass, 300 px wide, with the bay label 'FLAT 103' etc. in Jost 500 22 px tracked .32em under it), on SHOP 1's fascia (P1: kit/naira-wordmark-cream-blush.svg, 560 px wide on the sage-deep fascia), on the gate board (P3) and alone on the corner tower's crown (P12). On P1 and P3 the plate carries the bay label only ('SHOP 1', 'THE GATE'), so no frame ever shows two marks. The typed 'NAIRA PETITE', 'NAIRA NIWAS', 'NAIRA NIWAS CO-OPERATIVE HOUSING SOCIETY', 'NIWAS' and 'निवास' are all removed from images. 'Naira Niwas' as a season name lives only in captions, pending the owner's yes; fallback 'our building'. Because the plate now carries the real wordmark, the end card (the same brass plate scaled up, its flower turning on the I's stem at 36 degrees a second) and the cover lockup are one object.
system_changes.emblem: C-KANDIL stays: the blush akash kandil at tile x 140 on all 12 covers, one torsion per 10.0 s, sway +-1.2 degrees per 6.4 s, unlit on bays not yet posted. Default window: the kit I-flower cut out and lit, with its 14% ghost on the plaster (inside the 6-15% ghost rule); owner sign-off required, with the four-petal jaali window built in parallel as a one-file swap. Before anything else, a 10 s test render of the torsion, pulled at 0, 2.5, 5 and 7.5 s: if the facet-width swap reads as breathing rather than turning, build it as a CSS 3D octahedron (two pyramids, rotateY) or fall back to sway only. The kandil is never a joke in copy; A's 'the kandil stays up all month' line is A's.
system_changes.piece_entrance: GRAFT (DRAWN FROM LIFE): in every reel the piece first appears in the window's dark state as its own traced outline (potrace of the cut-out's alpha, 3 px, sage-deep #3F5A4C in light rooms and cream #F6EFE6 in night rooms, drawn with stroke-dashoffset at about 520 px/s), and as LIGHTS ON warms the room the photograph develops in exactly that footprint (opacity 0 to 1, blur 6 to 0 px, scale 1.035 to 1, 0.9 s, cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)) while the outline retracts from both ends (0.7 s, overlap at least 0.4 s). The building is drawn; the piece is drawn until the light finds it.
system_changes.honesty_rules: GRAFT (DRAWN FROM LIFE + GALLI): (1) no drawn line, chalk, rail, string, strand or thread comes within 14 px of a piece (P4's chalk line passes through the cuff's gap, never over metal); (2) inside a window the piece and its one prop keep true relative size at the stated px/mm; any frame where a piece reads larger than life says '(shown larger.)' in Jost 300 20 px; (3) words only from the listing; 'green cubic zirconia' never 'emerald' or 'emerald-green'; 'purple' in body copy for the Amethyst variant; 'ruby-red cubic zirconia', never ruby as a stone claim; gold only ever as '18k gold tone plated'; water and tarnish words only in captions and only on tagged pieces; 'made to stay gold.' removed everywhere.
system_changes.reel_wrapper: P1 keeps the full establishing (0.8 s) and find (1.8 s) because it teaches the system. From P4 on: establishing 0.6 s (this week's kandil lights at 0.2 s), find 1.6 s, pull-back 1.8 s, so each reel's own scene gets the time. End card holds at least 2.6 s on every reel (fixes P4 2.1, P7 2.1, P10 1.9). Only P1 keeps the two 120 ms tube blinks.
system_changes.sound: GRAFT (THE BOX THEATRE, re-skinned): one soft brass lift-bell 'ding' as this week's kandil lights in every reel's establishing shot: the series is recognisable with the screen off. Under it the existing 1.2 s building ambience, 2-4 timed foley hits per reel, one instrumental from the Instagram library, never lyrics; carousels silent.
system_changes.loops: GRAFT (GALLI's loop discipline): every ambient period divides its loop length; frame 0 of every carousel slide 1 is the cover; no cross-fade loops (P11's moonrise slide is cut; P9's 9 s phase-lock is replaced by a 10 s loop on the kandil's own cycle). Every carousel slide 1 carries a native action, not only a light sweep (P2 soap dish, P5 sun bar on mirror versus satin, P11 moonlight bead by bead). Fidget loops slowed: P8 chit and P9 notice sway at most +-1.5 degrees on a 3.2 s period; P8's fan shadow turns once per 10 s.
system_changes.end_card: C-ENDCARD on every reel and the last slide of every carousel: the brass plate with the real wordmark, its flower turning on the I's stem; eyebrow '<BAY> · <STOREY>' in Jost (no typed NAIRA); piece name (Velista carries È, so RIVIÈRE may be Velista; prices, middots and N° always Jost with the Poppins rupee); material bracket; live price from roster.json on render day; nairaflore.com; the post's one Cormorant line; and GRAFT (GALLI) the service line 'every piece arrives in the Naira box · free insured shipping · COD available' at the foot of all twelve.
system_changes.box: One render path: the CSS box from kit/motion/demo-box.html (proportions from NairaBoxCSS.tsx), finished with GRAFT (THE BOX THEATRE) AP-02 satin paperboard texture at multiply .40, a 1 px rim light and a soft contact shadow; never three.js through SwiftShader, never mixed with another box look. Three-quarter view with the drawer out so the real black velvet bed shows only as a sliver around the piece (at most 3% of the tile). Measure a real box before render so P3 and P7 keep true scale. P3 slide 7 keeps the real listing photograph of the box (its lid print is that frame's one mark).
system_changes.grid_checks: Before week 1: render all 12 covers as a 3 x 4 composite at 391 x 521 above the live LAC / flower / BONE row, plus the two mid-week shifted states (every tile must read complete on its own when a row is part-posted). If the blush facade reads monotone, enlarge or deepen the opening colour fields; if the terrace end of the facade gradient (#DEA99D) reads tan, deepen it toward rose (#D79A9C), never toward brown. 0 pins; post strictly P1 to P12; Reorder grid if anything slips.
system_changes.first_comments: Every first comment: the post's prompt line, then 'Free insured shipping · Cash on delivery available', then at most 5 tags. 57% of orders are COD.
system_changes.captions: Owner's system: hook under 125 characters, one or two short lines, the exact offer line where listed, the [ piece · material · wink ] kicker last; no em dashes, no exclamation marks, no emoji, no urgency, no codes or percentages on any image.

keep_posts_summary: Kept whole with fixes: P1 BACK IN 5 MINUTES, P2 NO SOAP REQUIRED, P3 THE WATCHMAN KNOWS (one gift swapped), P4 WINDOW SEAT: STILL DISPUTED, P7 काही नको. posts.caption:
Tamarind and lemon: the whole afternoon before Diwali goes to the brass nameplate. Every flat, every year.

The Brushed Gold Huggies skip that step. About 12 mm across on a wide 6 mm band, brushed to a soft satin rather than a mirror shine, so they scatter light instead of throwing it back. Listed as tarnish free; a soft dry cloth after you wear them is all the care they ask. ₹999.

Gold coins are not sold here, downstairs or up. Shubh Dhanteras.

posts.caption:
One bulb is always out. Every ladi, every balcony, every Diwali.

On 101's balcony this line of light stays on: the Rivière Eternal Bracelet, one continuous row of round brilliant clear cubic zirconia, about 3 mm each, every stone in a fine four-prong setting, with a polished buckle station at the front. About 18 cm. 18k gold tone plated. ₹1,449.

It stacks with the Baguette Tennis Bracelet from Shop 1, ₹1,699. Take 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off, with codes BUY2 and BUY3 at checkout.

posts.caption:
The moon is back over the terrace. Nobody's fasting this time: it is wedding season, and the buffet opens at nine.

The Heartbead Bracelet takes both lights: mirror-polished rhodium coated beads, about 6 mm, for the moon, and at the front a gold tone toggle and one puffed gold tone heart, about 15 mm, for the string lights. Cool and quiet, warm only at the front. ₹1,299.

Take 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off, with codes BUY2 and BUY3 at checkout. Free insured shipping. Cash on delivery available.

[ heartbead bracelet · rhodium plated with a gold tone heart · one warm thing on the terrace ]
